Metadata.description: Your building's payments, balance, announcements and schedules, in one place for residents and the committee.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The link may be wrong, or the page may have moved.

Auth.panelDescription: Payments, announcements and schedules for your building, in one place.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.heading: Sign in to Lobbie
SignIn.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password needed.
SignIn.expired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Enter your email to get a new one.
SignIn.signInFailed: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.

SignInForm.rateLimited: Too many attempts; try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

SignInErrors.invalidEmail: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
SignInErrors.sendFailed: We couldn't send the email. Please try again in a moment.

CheckEmail.title: Check your email
CheckEmail.body: We've sent you a sign-in link. It works once and is valid for 15 minutes.
CheckEmail.sentTo: We've sent a sign-in link to <address>{email}</address>. It works once and is valid for 15 minutes.
CheckEmail.hint: Can't find it? Look in your spam folder.

Join.title: Join your building
Join.body: Ask your building committee for an invite link, then open it on this device to join your apartment.

Authz.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
Authz.noMembership: You're not a member of a building yet.
Authz.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.

Email.subject: Your Lobbie sign-in link
Email.intro: Here's your link to sign in to Lobbie:
Email.expiry: The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
Email.ignore: If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email.

ErrorPage.title: Something went wrong
ErrorPage.body: We couldn't load this page. Try again, or go back home.

StatusCard.title: Your payments
StatusCard.monthsBehind: You're {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} behind
StatusCard.noFeeBody: The committee hasn't set a fee for {month}, so there's nothing to pay.
StatusCard.notBilledBody: Once the committee starts billing, you'll see here whether you're paid up.
StatusCard.noApartmentTitle: You're not linked to an apartment yet
StatusCard.noApartmentBody: Ask your building committee to add you to your apartment.
StatusCard.rowOverdue: {amount} owed · {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} behind

Demo.readOnly: This is a demo building, so changes are turned off.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.lead: Manage the building and its money.
Admin.buildingLinkBody: Name, address, quorum and billing, and corrections to the fund.
Admin.noToolsYet: The committee's tools, such as payments and announcements, will appear here as they're added.
Admin.apartmentsLinkBody: Add, edit and remove apartments, and set when each starts paying.

AdminBuilding.title: Building details
AdminBuilding.openingBalanceHint: Set when the building was created. To correct the fund, add an adjustment.
AdminBuilding.emptyBody: If the fund doesn’t match the bank, record the difference here with a reason.

BuildingForm.name: Building name
BuildingForm.quorumHint: The share of apartments that must take part, in percent.
BuildingForm.billingStartHint: Apartments owe the monthly fee from this month on, unless they have their own start. Without a month picker, type it as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-01.
BuildingForm.confirmBody: Billing would start in {to} instead of {from}. This changes what every apartment owes, past months included.

BuildingErrors.name: Enter a name of 2 to 80 characters.
BuildingErrors.quorumPercent: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
BuildingErrors.saveFailed: We couldn’t save the details. Please try again.

AdjustmentForm.title: Add an adjustment
AdjustmentForm.description: Corrects the building fund. It’s recorded with your name and today’s date.
AdjustmentForm.reasonHint: For example: bank fees not recorded earlier.

AdjustmentErrors.direction: Choose whether the money is added to the fund or taken from it.
AdjustmentErrors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, such as 250 or 1,200.50.
AdjustmentErrors.reason: Write a reason of 3 to 200 characters.
AdjustmentErrors.addFailed: We couldn’t add the adjustment. Please try again.

AdminApartments.title: Apartments
AdminApartments.count: {count, plural, one {One apartment} other {# apartments}}, by floor
AdminApartments.residentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No residents} one {One resident} other {# residents}}
AdminApartments.emptyBody: Add each apartment with its number and floor. Then you can invite the people who live there.

ApartmentForm.addDescription: Its residents join later, with an invite link.
ApartmentForm.editDescription: The number and floor are how residents and the committee find it.
ApartmentForm.numberHint: Up to 10 characters, for example 7 or 12A.
ApartmentForm.floorHint: 0 is the ground floor; below it, -1 and down.
ApartmentForm.billingStartHint: Leave it empty to use the building’s month. Without a month picker, type it as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-01.
ApartmentForm.confirmTitle: Change when this apartment’s billing starts?
ApartmentForm.confirmBody: Billing would start {to} instead of {from}. This changes what the apartment owes, past months included.

ApartmentRemove.title: Remove apartment {number}?
ApartmentRemove.description: No one lives in it and it has no payments, so nothing else changes. This can’t be undone.

ApartmentErrors.number: Enter a number of 1 to 10 characters.
ApartmentErrors.floor: Enter a whole number from -5 to 200.
ApartmentErrors.billingStartMonth: Choose a month, such as 2026-01, or leave it empty.
ApartmentErrors.notFound: This apartment no longer exists. Reload the page to see the current list.
ApartmentErrors.saveFailed: We couldn’t save the apartment. Please try again.
ApartmentErrors.removeFailed: We couldn’t remove the apartment. Please try again.
ApartmentErrors.hasHistory: It can’t be removed: other records still point to it.

ApartmentBlockers.residents: Move or remove its {count, plural, one {resident} other {# residents}} first.
ApartmentBlockers.payments: It has payment history, which is kept.
ApartmentBlockers.feeOverrides: It has its own fee history, which is kept.
